exact_analysis.header:
name: HIA Core-only
on: [push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch]

conditioned_steps.header: name: Preserve actual cold failure and stage evidence
name: Preserve final JSON wire caller evidence

required_identity_chain: Wait for the separate formal Source CI and use its actual verified candidate tree; the local e295 tree is not a substitute for that returned authority.
Root creates one isolated candidate commit C with the verified tree and exactly the authorized parents f33d8da316de8fdf27b504371f1a5310997ff548 and a733926a2786a3d4a37304bd2d18ebb2eac57ac9.
Verify commit/tree/workflow6b390 bytes by full Git readback, then create one previously absent isolated source branch at C through the existing authenticated repository connector.
Do not wrap the original workflow in another branch whose checkout is later redirected to C. Let the original push workflow run directly from C.
Select the actual run only when event=push, head_sha=C, head_branch=the new isolated branch and path=.github/workflows/hia-core.yml.
Verify both actual checkout logs point to C. The unchanged checkout action uses github.context.ref and github.context.sha when no ref is supplied for the workflow repository.
Keep the isolated branch fixed during this execution. Do not use a pull_request run as proof of the exact C checkout because that event uses the PR merge ref.

Collect both original job logs and the two original always-upload artifacts keyed by C/run_attempt. Preserve failure and skipped-step statuses; an early Native failure does not mean the remaining business steps ran.

trigger_boundary.publisher: Use the already established external connector publication route, not a push made with the running workflow's GITHUB_TOKEN.
trigger_boundary.rationale: GitHub suppresses new push-triggered workflow runs arising from GITHUB_TOKEN recursion; this is avoided by the existing connector route.

  native:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.14.4'
      - name: Install qualified Clang 20 native execution prerequisites
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" https://apt.llvm.org/llvm-snapshot.gpg.key
          fingerprint=$(gpg --show-keys --with-colons "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" | awk -F: '$1 == "fpr" { print $10; exit }')
          test "$fingerprint" = 6084F3CF814B57C1CF12EFD515CF4D18AF4F7421
          sudo install -m 0644 "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" /usr/share/keyrings/hia-llvm.asc
          printf '%s\n' 'deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/hia-llvm.asc] https://apt.llvm.org/noble/ llvm-toolchain-noble-20 main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/hia-llvm20.list
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y binutils gcc clang-20 libclang-rt-20-dev strace
          printf 'CLANG=/usr/bin/clang-20\nHEPTA_CLANG=/usr/bin/clang-20\n' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: python -m pip install setuptools==78.1.1 wheel==0.46.3 z3-solver==4.15.4.0 jsonschema==4.26.0
      - name: Prepare original locked Rust caller dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo --version
          rustc --version
          sha256sum rust/hia-core-shadow/Cargo.toml rust/hia-core-shadow/Cargo.lock > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-rust-caller-inputs.sha256"
          cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path rust/hia-core-shadow/Cargo.toml
          sha256sum --check "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-rust-caller-inputs.sha256"
          git diff --exit-code -- rust/hia-core-shadow/Cargo.toml rust/hia-core-shadow/Cargo.lock
      - run: python -B tools/replay_hia_selfhost_cold.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-cold.json"
      - name: Original call graph and native convergence controls
        run: python -B tools/run_hia_unittest_gate.py tests.test_hia_selfhost_call_graph_efficiency.CallGraphNativeTests
      - run: python -B tests/test_hia_selfhost_language_coverage.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-language.json"
      - name: Prepare isolated continuation-family evidence
        run: mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-continuation-family"
      - name: Native linked loader and compiler receipt bindings
        run: |
          python -B - <<'PYBINDINGS'
          from hashlib import sha256
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import unittest
          from tools.build_hia_json_preflight import admit_cold_build
          cold_path = Path(os.environ['HEPTA_HIA_LINKED_OBSERVER_COLD_REPORT'])
          cold_bytes = cold_path.read_bytes()
          PYEVALUATION82
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_SERVICE_EVALUATION_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_SERVICE_EVALUATION_EVIDENCE: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-continuation-family/hia-service-evaluation
      - name: Native evaluation through all original 48 Agent callers
        run: python -B tools/qualify_hia_service_evaluation.py --cold-report "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-cold.json" --caller-group agent --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-continuation-family/hia-service-evaluation-agent"
      - name: Native evaluation through all original 35 namespace callers
        run: python -B tools/qualify_hia_service_evaluation.py --cold-report "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-cold.json" --caller-group namespace --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-continuation-family/hia-service-evaluation-namespace"
      - name: Native evaluation through all original 48 ledger callers
        run: python -B tools/qualify_hia_service_evaluation.py --cold-report "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-cold.json" --caller-group ledger --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-continuation-family/hia-service-evaluation-ledger"
      - name: Native JSON wire entry, exact graph budgets, key cache and installed resources
        run: python -B tools/run_hia_unittest_gate.py tests.test_hia_json_wire_native tests.test_hia_json_wire_entry tests.test_hia_json_wire_cache
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_JSON_WIRE_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_JSON_WIRE_FIXTURE_EVIDENCE: ${{ runner.temp }}/json-wire-fixture
          HEPTA_HIA_JSON_WIRE_ENTRY_FIXTURE_EVIDENCE: ${{ runner.temp }}/json-wire-entry-fixture
          HEPTA_HIA_JSON_WIRE_CACHE_FIXTURE_EVIDENCE: ${{ runner.temp }}/json-wire-cache-fixture
      - name: Original ordinary callers through HIA JSON wire
        run: >-
          python -B tools/qualify_hia_json_wire_native_callers.py
          --cold-report "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-cold.json"
          --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-json-wire-callers.json"
          --evidence-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-json-wire-callers"
